event: Senne Vareth recognises the inscription wall's script: not the letters, the substrate.
The depth and pressure of each cut carry the writer's body and state of mind.
She has spent forty-three years reading exactly that variation.
The entrance keeper has briefed her; she takes no notes until she has read the source.
Twenty-one inscriptions; the newest, TOVA FENN, still settling into the stone.
Its even, uniform cuts were made by a system performing a function: it records, not grieves.

changes.note: Deep Reading of the inscription wall, counted as one activation

event: The military entries share an institutional regularity that breaks at the word SCRIBE.
She reads all twenty-one in three hours; the keeper brings her water and says nothing.
She was not compelled: six months ago a colleague described the wall as rough, functional.
That was wrong, and she set down forty years' work on a dead civilisation's text and walked.
The wall is a living archive, learning over decades how to describe what it records.
She came to read what was written; vocation is close to the word, not close enough.
She asks if anyone entered with written materials: the researcher's notebook, in the Crucible.
"Are there any marks left by entrants inside?" The keeper sees a document anew. "Several."
The Gullet is organic like a living specimen, warm, present as a sleeping body.
She is not afraid: organisms are legible; everything that persists leaves marks.
The Ledger: Depth 2, the Marrow Warrens, Resolve +1, now 16.

changes.note: Depth transition into the Marrow Warrens, Resolve +1

event: The Ledger names her The Reach, with the Gift Deep Reading: she reads a writing as its writer made it.
Its Cost is The Frame Dissolves: each reading, less sure which side of the inscription she is on.
The Ledger reads Vitality 11, Resolve 16, Attunement 9, Fortune 14.
Voluntary: she came because there was a text. The Maw is watching.
The Gift is not alien but a sharper version of herself; costs are precise.
At a junction she reads a 6B charcoal mark: a surveyor's notation, precise, unhurried.

changes.note: Deep Reading of the surveyor's charcoal mark

event: At another, a pressed directional sign; reading it, she must rebuild who is who.

changes.note: Deep Reading of the pressed directional sign

event: She reconstructs the distinction, and notes the effort.
The Ledger: Depth 3, the Still Garden, Resolve +1, now 17.

changes.note: Depth transition into the Still Garden, Resolve +1

event: The creature is marked: the Keystone's crack, its revision, the Cull's seeping wound.
On its shell are the Brand's technical marks, in a notation she can read: systems have grammar.
The Patient tracks her and does not lunge, assessing her as she assesses an inscription.
She stops ten meters off, beyond its strike range.
She sees the Cull's knife on the floor by where its maker fell.
Four hands across years have written on the creature's body; the creature is the parchment.
She reads the Brand's notation in seven minutes: six stress points and a sequence of strikes.

changes.note: Deep Reading of the Brand's notation on The Patient

event: Its small note: if three, try left center seam first. The crack is at the left center seam.
The marks worked: the Brand mapped it, and the Keystone read the map.
Twenty more minutes on the sub-system, and she has drifted to six meters from it.
They are very still, reading each other, and the frame slips.
She steps back to ten meters, deliberately; rebuilding herself takes longer.
She is Senne Vareth, sixty-eight, and the notebook is at Depth 4. She takes the western bypass.
The Ledger: Depth 4, the Crucible, Resolve +1, now 18.

changes.note: Depth transition into the Crucible, Resolve +1

event: The warmth is inside her rather than on her; her joints stiffen as the records said.
The notebook lies between the two death sites, its cover warped, its paper desiccated, not rotted.
She sits beside it and puts her hand on the cover.
Deep Reading gives her the researcher who saw curiosity was itself a kind of compulsion.

changes.note: Deep Reading of Aldous Vren's notebook

event: I cannot tell the difference, and that is the answer to my question.
She receives his death, notating until he could not: I am here. I came here.
Seven minutes; the frame now needs active maintenance.
She stands, looks at the courier's tube, and does not go to it: she has read enough.
She turns toward the exit, about twenty minutes from the threshold.
Reading the quartz's radiating pattern, she sees it stop at the Emanator's base.
A flat space a meter and a half wide; in it, two human hands pressed to the creature.
The quartz has grown round the wrists, not over the palms: the contact has held.
She knows it as a fact from the keeper; reading it as a document is different.
She crosses and crouches at the edge of Vigil's Rest, the pressure on one side only.
She puts her hand on the hands, and Deep Reading activates.

changes.note: Deep Reading of Tova Fenn's hands

event: She receives a midwife holding her 848th: a creature older than any language she has read.
She receives the thirty-one minutes, the four, and the correspondence.
The frame breaks: she cannot say what the dungeon is reading her as.
Forty-three years she read things that could not read her back.
The dungeon laid its materials out in order: wall, marks, notation, notebook, hands.
She has been reading the dungeon; the dungeon has been writing her.
Which side of the inscription is she on? The frame has dissolved.
Her grasp of the facts is whole: joints severe, sight a coin, breath beginning to fail.
What is gone is her certainty of standing apart from them.
The midwife's Gift is still holding; she reads the act, not the effect.
I am reading an act of holding. I am holding the record of it. I am inside the record.
The threshold comes like the last clause of a sentence sixty-eight years long.

changes.note: Senne dies of the Crucible Emanator's emanation, Vitality 11 to 0

event: Quartz, growth rings, two hands, and her own on top: three layers, reading all the way down.
The death report: Senne Vareth, the Reach, Depth 4; six readings, the frame fully dissolved.
Thirty-eight minutes: the longest survival at Depth 4, thanks to Vigil's Rest.
A midwife who held things past her own death held a scholar past hers.
Her Memory Crystal is gold: love, the kind that is indistinguishable from vocation.
She read the dungeon; the dungeon read her. Neither was wrong.
Ledger note: she is the first to notice who writes the Ledger. The Ledger is the answer.
For the third time in a row the Ledger records the crystal first.
The Maw has never asked who authors the Ledger: is it a text writing itself?
It notes: the instrument of understanding is also what is being understood.
It adds no category for her; the name is sufficient.
At the Emanator's base, her hand rests on Tova's hands, and Tova's Hold still holds.
Osren records the glow: gold, twelve seconds, the first gold and the longest yet.
The effects box is full; he notes that a second container is needed.
The fire burns, and evening begins: 978 remain.
SENNE VARETH — DEPTH 4 — FIRST TO READ.
